summary: Wakupator is a utility designed to manage Wake-on-LAN procedures based on observed network traffic. Written in C and distributed under the MIT licence, it provides a lightweight way to trigger machine wake states automatically. Because specific protocol and interface details are sparse, it operates within the standard domain of network traffic monitors and power management tools.
goodFor: It is suited for administrators looking for a minimal, compiled utility to automate machine power states in response to local network activity.
